products.name: The Zawadi Frame
products.tagline: A personalised frame for the moment you want to keep.
products.description: Your photo, framed with the names, date and words that make it yours. Thoughtfully designed in London and made especially for you — a gift for a new baby, a newly married couple, a graduate, or anyone with a moment worth keeping.

products.name: Stitched Pictures
products.tagline: Your photo, finished with stitched detail you can feel.
products.description: A favourite photo brought to life with hand-stitched details — a name, a date or a few words, sewn by hand so the moment has texture as well as colour.

products.name: Embroidered Pictures
products.tagline: Embroidery on your picture, made especially for you.
products.description: Your picture with embroidered details added by hand — delicate flowers, initials or a little motif that makes it unmistakably yours.
